::: {#exm-racket-neighbors}
#### Neighbors and degrees in Racket

With `office` as in @exr-racket-assoc,
these functions return the neighbors (@def-adjacent) and the degree (@def-degree) of a vertex of a graph with no loops or parallel edges:

```{racket}
#| code-fold: false
(define (neighbors G v)
  (rest (assoc v G)))

(define (degree G v)
  (length (neighbors G v)))
```

For the vertex $b$:

```{racket}
#| code-fold: false
(neighbors office 'b)
(degree office 'b)
```

`(for/sum ([x L]) body)` adds up the values of `body` for each element `x` of the list `L`,
so this sum of the degrees of the six vertices is $2 \card{E}$, as @thm-handshake says:

```{racket}
#| code-fold: false
(for/sum ([row office])
  (degree office (first row)))
```

:::
